name: Amazon Rainforest Protection
description: Protecting vital rainforest ecosystems from deforestation across 200,000 hectares of the Amazon basin. This REDD+ project prevents the release of over 2 million tonnes of CO2 annually while preserving biodiversity and supporting indigenous communities.

name: Sahara Solar Farm
description: Large-scale concentrated solar power (CSP) plant in the Sahara desert generating 580MW of clean electricity for North Africa, displacing fossil fuel generation and creating 1,200 local jobs.

name: North Sea Wind Farm
description: Offshore wind energy production featuring 120 turbines in the North Sea, generating enough clean power for 600,000 households annually. Verified under the Gold Standard methodology.

name: Climeworks Direct Air Capture
description: Cutting-edge direct air capture facility using geothermal energy to remove CO2 directly from the atmosphere and permanently store it underground as mineral carbonates.

name: Borneo Peatland Restoration
description: Restoring degraded peatlands in Borneo by rewetting and revegetating 50,000 hectares, preventing massive carbon emissions from peat decomposition and fires while restoring orangutan habitat.

name: Kenya Cookstove Distribution
description: Distributing 100,000 energy-efficient cookstoves to rural Kenyan households, reducing firewood consumption by 60% and preventing indoor air pollution that causes respiratory disease.

name: Pacific Blue Carbon Mangroves
description: Planting and protecting 15,000 hectares of mangrove forests along the Philippine coastline. Mangroves sequester 5x more carbon than terrestrial forests and protect communities from typhoons.

name: Patagonia Wind Power Complex
description: A 350MW onshore wind farm in Patagonia harnessing some of the world's strongest and most consistent winds to generate clean power for Buenos Aires and surrounding regions.

name: Enhanced Rock Weathering
description: Spreading crushed basalt on agricultural land to accelerate natural CO2 absorption through rock weathering. This dual-purpose approach also improves soil fertility and crop yields.

name: Rajasthan Solar Microgrid
description: Deploying solar microgrids across 200 rural villages in Rajasthan, replacing diesel generators and kerosene lamps with clean energy while enabling economic development for 50,000 people.

name: Congo Basin Forest Conservation
description: Protecting 1.2 million hectares of pristine tropical rainforest in the Congo Basin — the world's second largest rainforest — through community-based forest management and anti-poaching patrols.

name: Biochar Carbon Removal
description: Converting agricultural waste into biochar through pyrolysis and incorporating it into soil for permanent carbon storage. Each tonne of biochar locks away 3 tonnes of CO2 for centuries.
